```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
library(gtExtras)
library(readxl)

source('../../ccMeetTools.R')
boysVarsity <- read_excel('bcc0916.xlsx', sheet='boysVarsity') |> 
  rename_with(~ str_to_title(.x)) |> rename(Time = Time_seconds)
girlsVarsity <- read_excel('bcc0916.xlsx', sheet='girlsVarsity') |> 
  rename_with(~ str_to_title(.x)) |> rename(Time = Time_seconds)
```

## Competition summary

buildTeamTable(boysVarsity, "D.H. Conley", maxAth=12)
